recipe.build:
cd android-studio-project
chmod +x gradlew
wget -q -O /tmp/gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip -- https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip
sha256sum -c <<< 'bed1da33cca0f557ab13691c77f38bb67388119e4794d113e051039b80af9bb1  /tmp/gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip'
unzip -q -d /opt /tmp/gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/gradle-7.6.4/bin"
JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64 gradle :Mock-my-GPS:assembleWithAllLanguageTranslationsWithAospLocationProvidersRelease
mv Mock-my-GPS/build/outputs/apk/withAllLanguageTranslationsWithAospLocationProviders/release/Mock-my-GPS-*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
